# ScrizaOne (Scriza Private Limited)

> ScrizaOne (https://scrizaone.com) is the international website of Scriza Private Limited, a software engineering company headquartered in Greater Noida, India. Core expertise: fintech integration and development (payment integrations, payments and bill-payment platforms, billing, ledgers and reconciliation). Also: AI agents and workflow automation, and custom software and SaaS. The India website is https://www.scriza.in.

## Company facts
- Legal entity: Scriza Private Limited (incorporated July 2022)
- CIN: U74999RJ2022PTC082624
- DGFT Importer Exporter Code (IEC): ABICS9865M
- Headquarters: NX One, T1 - 507, Tech Zone IV, Amrapali Dream Valley, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201318, India
- Registered office: 488, Pandit Plaza, Sector-9, Savina, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001, India
- Both company addresses are in India. Engineering is delivered remotely from India.
- Certifications: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (UQ-2026022728) and ISO 9001:2015 (QMS2600233), valid 27 Feb 2026 to 26 Feb 2029. Scope: IT service and support. They do not certify every product or service.
- Scriza is not a bank, payment institution, money transmitter or e-invoicing accredited service provider. It builds software and integrates with licensed providers.

- Reply time: within 24 hours; enquiries received on Wednesday or Friday may take longer
- Quotes are per project, by milestone, after a free discovery call, in the client's currency (USD, GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD, SGD or AED)

## Products built and operated by Scriza
- ScrizaPay: bill payments on India's Bharat Connect (BBPS) ecosystem (India-only service) — https://scrizapay.com
- HRVico: HRMS and payroll (primarily India) — https://hrvico.com
- Edu2All: school ERP (primarily India) — https://edu2all.in
- Hostelo: accommodation discovery (Indian cities) — https://hostelo.in
